description: This file defines the interface for the confui protocol in the cuttlefish project, including function declarations for message handling, command sending, and session management related to UI confirmation messages.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a ConfUiMessage to its string representation.

methods.name: RecvConfUiMsg
methods.description: Receives a confirmation UI message from a file descriptor, optionally with a session ID.

methods.name: SendAbortCmd
methods.description: Sends an abort command for a specific session.

methods.name: SendAck
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment or response message indicating success or failure.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with signed data and user selection.

methods.name: SendStartCmd
methods.description: Starts a UI session with prompt text, extra data, locale, and UI options.

methods.name: SendUserSelection
methods.description: Sends a user selection or cancel confirmation.

calls: SendStartCmd(fd, session_id, prompt_text, extra_data, locale, ui_opts)
